findings.governingReading: RIN the hitōban, the flying-head yōkai
findings.explanation: The named flying-head monster behind the later detachable-head gag is misparsed as a “tribe,” weakening the setup.

findings.governingReading: Shirou—BUCCHI-GILL! / Beat him bloody and KILL him
findings.explanation: The ruby-driven 殴・血・KILL construction that sounds out ぶちぎる while depicting violent fury is reduced to its plain target and intent.

findings.evidenceJa: タイガー道場第十九回
findings.explanation: The recurring show’s numbered installment is introduced as “the place,” producing an incoherent format label.
The payoff to the hitōban introduction loses the crucial implication that RIN’s severed or flying head has begun moving independently.
